create_identity_rotation: create a Rot3Array identity rotation matrix of a given shape using Rot3Array.identity
build_rotation_from_quaternion: build a Rot3Array rotation matrix from w, x, y, z quaternion components using from_quaternion
build_rotation_from_vectors: build a Rot3Array rotation matrix from two 3D vectors using from_two_vectors
apply_rotation_to_point: apply a Rot3Array rotation matrix to a Vec3Array point using apply_to_point
compose_rotations: compose two Rot3Array rotation matrices together using the matmul operator
